title.zh: 急售口罩熔喷布挤出机95级熔喷模具包过9管材

summary.zh: 该产品为挤出设备，主要材质为塑料，适用于口罩布等应用场景，支持规格定制与批量供货。
summary.en: This extrusion equipment is primarily made from Plastic and is suitable for extrusion production support applications. Custom dimensions and bulk supply are supported.

zh: 挤出设备面向工业与消费品配套场景，可用于防护、包覆、导向和连接等需求。
主要材质为塑料，可按项目要求匹配尺寸、壁厚、长度和结构形式，适配不同应用工况。
包装与交付可按需求配置（如重量(g) 2000000），支持稳定供货与长期项目协同。
en: This extrusion equipment is designed for industrial and consumer assembly programs requiring protection, covering, guidance, and connection functions.
The primary material is Plastic, and dimensions such as outer diameter, wall thickness, length, and profile form can be aligned to project requirements.
Packaging and delivery can be configured as needed (for example: Weight (g) 2000000), supporting stable supply and long-term project coordination.
